transcript:
[00:00] [Mira] The customer demo is on Friday. That is the event date, not the deadline for the migration plan.
[00:10] [Owen] I can review the plan, but I cannot own it. I will be away tomorrow.
[00:20] [Mira] Leah, can you prepare the migration plan by Thursday?
[00:30] [Leah] Yes. I can prepare the plan, but Thursday is too early. I will send it on Monday instead.
[00:40] [Mira] Monday is agreed. Leah owns preparation; Owen only reviews. Please correct the old Thursday entry.
[00:50] [Owen] Understood. My review has no agreed deadline yet.
[01:00] [Mira] The migration itself is not approved. It can start only after the security review passes.
[01:10] [Leah] We still do not know whether support staff need training. Leave that question open.
